tool_args.rationale: The base-field, sink-gradient, and lag signatures favor the coupled siphon-memory ODE. The pilot covers the target horizon of 0.46, but its five rows over H = 0.38–0.52 do not establish that the five parameters can be estimated reliably enough for RMSE ≤ 0.045. The trajectory batch is the relevant probe for separating the coupled dynamics.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter siphon-memory ODE now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five observations at similar horizons provide no residual degrees of freedom and little leverage to separate memory coupling from its relaxation time.
It represents gradient inhibition but omits the observed coupled transient lag.
It does not distinguish the candidate mechanisms or constrain their parameters.
